name: Service Tax Designation 1
definition: Designates the tax calculation to be applied on a service.

Code.name: Code
Code.definition: Identifies the taxable status of the service.

Region.name: Region
Region.definition: Defines the tax region associated with the service. This element must be present if taxes are involved with any portion of the statement.

TaxReason.name: Tax Reason
TaxReason.definition: Provides free form explanations of the various tax codes used within the statement.

RegionPresenceRule.definition: If Region is present, then Code must be equal to ZeroRate or Taxable.
